meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数据变成有说服力的故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常需要向别人解释数据背后的含义
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain the meaning behind data to others

howto.what: 把原始数据转成有说服力的叙述,运用可视化、背景和故事结构;提供问题-解决、趋势、对比等框架和高管摘要、数据故事流程、一页看板等模板,输出含标题、洞察、建议与行动呼吁。
howto.when: 当你要求向利益相关者展示分析、创建数据报告或制作高管演示时触发;也适用于季度业务回顾、投资者演示等场景。

say.text: 把这份销售周报变成一个数据故事,先说最重要的结论。
say.note: Claude 会按故事结构组织,先给关键洞察。

say.text: 用问题-解决方案框架分析客户流失数据,给出建议。
say.note: 会生成包含背景、问题、洞察、解决方案的叙述。

say.text: 为季度业务回顾做一个一页看板,标出亮点和风险。
say.note: 输出单页摘要,含关键指标和推荐动作。

howto.what_en: Turns raw data into persuasive narratives using visualization, context, and story structure. Provides frameworks (problem-solution, trend, comparison) and templates (executive summary, story flow, one-page dashboard) to produce insights, recommendations, and calls to action.
howto.when_en: Triggered when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations, and similar data-driven reporting scenarios.

say_en.text: Turn this sales weekly report into a data story, starting with the most important conclusion.
say_en.note: Claude starts with the key insight.

say_en.text: Analyze customer churn data using the problem-solution framework and give recommendations.
say_en.note: Generates a narrative with context, problem, insight, and solution.

say_en.text: Create a one-page dashboard for the quarterly business review, highlighting wins and risks.
say_en.note: Outputs a single-page summary with key metrics and next actions.
